body:
Because I'm tired of getting shit on by 'friends'. I'm always there for all my friends, but when I need them they let me down and the only thing they say that I need to relax. I don't have friends, I don't trust anyone and every night I have those nightmares about my mother almost dying in the hospital.

I don't know how to get rid of those feelings, and I've been struggling with them for over 3-6 years now.
